fields.statement: At 5752832ae: go test -p 2 -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'TestRunReviewCheckRulings|TestReviewCheck' exit 0 (TestRunReviewCheckRulings plus the 6 existing TestReviewCheck* pass); go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/describe-golden exit 0, and with -update leaves no diff; rhiza docs, rhiza ship generate, rhiza render (scratch build) exit 0, render touching only other sessions' uncommitted actors.
